title: Final Entropy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the entropy σ in terms of n and N.

title: Entropy as Function of U
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the entropy σ as a function of total energy U and N.

title: Planck Distribution Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the derivation of the total energy U at temperature τ leading to the Planck distribution.

title: Counting Method Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the counting method used to derive the multiplicity function g(N, n).

title: Sign and Factor Checks
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or missing factors in the entropy expressions.
